SFixture: John 7, in the words of the WEB
Pm
V1
TAfter these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
V2
TNow the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
V3
THis brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
V4
TFor no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
V5
TFor even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
Pm
V6
TJesus therefore said to them,
W “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
V7
WThe world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
V8
WYou go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
Pm
V9
THaving said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
V10
TBut when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
V11
TThe Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
V12
TThere was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
V13
TYet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
V14
TBut when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
V15
TThe Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
Pm
V16
TJesus therefore answered them,
W “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
V17
WIf anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
V18
WHe who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
V19
WDidn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
Pm
V20
TThe multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
Pm
V21
TJesus answered them,
W “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
V22
WMoses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
V23
WIf a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
V24
WDon’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
Pm
V25
TTherefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
V26
TBehold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
V27
THowever, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
Pm
V28
TJesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying,
W “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
V29
WI know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
Pm
V30
TThey sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
V31
TBut of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
V32
TThe Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
Pm
V33
TThen Jesus said,
W “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
V34
WYou will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
Pm
V35
TThe Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
V36
TWhat is this word that he said,
W ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’
T and
W ‘Where I am, you can’t come’
T?”
Pm
V37
TNow on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out,
W “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
V38
WHe who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
V39
TBut he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
Pm
V40
TMany of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
V41
TOthers said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
V42
THasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
V43
TSo a division arose in the multitude because of him.
V44
TSome of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
V45
TThe officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
Pm
V46
TThe officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
Pm
V47
TThe Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
V48
THave any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
V49
TBut this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
Pm
V50
TNicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
V51
T“Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
Pm
V52
TThey answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
Pm
V53
TEveryone went to his own house,
